abstract.t: This document specifies the Secure Low-Latency Interactive Messaging (SLIM), a protocol designed to support real-time interactive AI applications at scale. SLIM provides a name-routed messaging data plane and session layer for agent protocols such as A2A and MCP. The data plane carries Protocol Buffers messages over streaming gRPC on HTTP/2 or WebSocket, while the session layer provides point-to-point and group communication, configurable reliable delivery, and optional end-to-end encryption using MLS. SLIM also defines link negotiation between routing nodes and control messages for session establishment and group membership.
